image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of an antique aneroid barometer. The instrument features a circular dial with a brass or gold-toned bezel and a glass cover. The face is off-white/cream with black numerical markings (likely inches of mercury) and weather condition text ('STORMY', 'RAIN', 'CHANGEABLE', 'FAIR', 'DRY'). A thin black pointer hand indicates the current pressure. The casing appears to be dark wood. There is visible noise/grain in the image, suggesting it might be an older photograph or heavily processed.
